items.title: FinancialJuice: Goldman Sachs: Gold - FJElite
items.summary: Last week, we flagged tactical downside risk from potential equity-driven deleveraging, and that risk has now materialized. The sharp equity drawdown — linked to the uncertainty over the AI cycle — triggered margin calls and broader deleveraging, contributing to gold’s 8% w/w decline. Weaker momentum subsequently triggered additional CTA selling, amplifying the move.
